        "contents": "use std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse anyhow::anyhow;\nuse sha1::digest::Output;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse crate::protocol::FileChange;\n\nconst ZERO_OID: &amp;str = \"0000000000000000000000000000000000000000\";\nconst DEV_NULL: &amp;str = \"/dev/null\";\n\nstruct BaselineFileInfo {\n    path: PathBuf,\n    content: Vec&lt;u8&gt;,\n    mode: FileMode,\n    oid: String,\n}\n\n/// Tracks sets of changes to files and exposes the overall unified diff.\n/// Internally, the way this works is now:\n/// 1.         "contents": "//! Quarantine System for Malware Detection\n//!\n//! Provides safe isolation, deletion, and restoration of detected malware files.\n\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::fs;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tracing::{debug, info, warn};\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\n/// Quarantine entry status\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum QuarantineStatus {\n    /// File is quarantined and isolated\n    Quarantined,\n    /// File has been permanently deleted\n    Deleted,\n    /// File has been restored to original location\n    Restored,\n}\n\n/// Quarantine entry\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct QuarantineEntry {\n    /// Unique quarantine ID\n    pub id: String,\n    /// Original file path\n    pub original_path: PathBuf,\n    /// Quarantine location\n    pub quarantine_path: PathBuf,\n    /// Threat name/type\n    pub threat_name: String,\n    /// Detection confidence (0.0-1.0)\n    pub confidence: f32,\n    /// Quarantine timestamp\n    pub quarantined_at: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n    /// Current status\n    pub status: QuarantineStatus,\n    /// File hash (SHA256) for verification\n    pub file_hash: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Additional metadata\n    pub metadata: BTreeMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Quarantine Manager\npub struct Quarantine {\n    /// Quarantine directory\n    quarantine_dir: PathBuf,\n    /// Active quarantine entries\n    entries: Arc&lt;RwLock&lt;BTreeMap&lt;String, QuarantineEntry&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Quarantine statistics\n    stats: Arc&lt;RwLock&lt;QuarantineStats&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Quarantine statistics\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\nstruct QuarantineStats {\n    total_quarantined: usize,\n    total_deleted: usize,\n    total_restored: usize,\n    total_size_bytes: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Quarantine",

        "contents": "use crate::error::CodexErr;\nuse crate::error::Result;\nuse codex_protocol::ThreadId;\nuse std::collections::BTreeSet;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\nuse std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize;\nuse std::sync::atomic::Ordering;\n\n/// This structure is used to add some limits on the multi-agent capabilities for Codex. In\n/// the current implementation, it limits:\n/// * Total number of sub-agents (i.e. threads) per user session\n///\n/// This structure is shared by all agents in the same user session (because the &#96;AgentControl&#96;\n/// is).\n#[derive(Default)]\npub(crate) struct Guards {\n    threads_set: Mutex&lt;BTreeSet&lt;ThreadId&gt;&gt;,\n    total_count: AtomicUsize,\n}\n\nimpl Guards {\n    pub(crate) fn reserve_spawn_slot(\n        self: &amp;Arc&lt;Self&gt;,\n        max_threads: Option&lt;usize&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;SpawnReservation&gt; {\n        if let Some(max_threads) = max_threads {\n            if !self.try_increment_spawned(max_threads) {\n                return Err(CodexErr::AgentLimitReached { max_threads });\n            }\n        } else {\n            self.total_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::AcqRel);\n        }\n        Ok(SpawnReservation {\n            state: Arc::clone(self),\n            active: true,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn release_spawned_thread(&amp;self, thread_id: ThreadId) {\n        let removed = {\n            let mut threads = self\n                .threads_set\n                .lock()\n                .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);\n            threads.remove(&amp;thread_id)\n        };\n        if removed {\n            self.total_count.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn register_spawned_thread(&amp;self, thread_id: ThreadId) {\n        let mut threads = self\n            .threads_set\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);\n        threads.insert(thread_id);\n    }\n\n    fn try_increment_spawned(&amp;self, max_threads: usize) -&gt; bool",

        "contents": "//! Shared approvals and sandboxing traits used by tool runtimes.\n//!\n//! Consolidates the approval flow primitives (&#96;ApprovalDecision&#96;, &#96;ApprovalStore&#96;,\n//! &#96;ApprovalCtx&#96;, &#96;Approvable&#96;) together with the sandbox orchestration traits\n//! and helpers (&#96;Sandboxable&#96;, &#96;ToolRuntime&#96;, &#96;SandboxAttempt&#96;, etc.).\n\nuse crate::codex::Session;\nuse crate::codex::TurnContext;\nuse crate::error::CodexErr;\nuse crate::protocol::SandboxPolicy;\nuse crate::sandboxing::CommandSpec;\nuse crate::sandboxing::SandboxManager;\nuse crate::sandboxing::SandboxTransformError;\nuse crate::state::SessionServices;\nuse codex_protocol::approvals::ExecPolicyAmendment;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::AskForApproval;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::ReviewDecision;\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::fmt::Debug;\nuse std::hash::Hash;\nuse std::path::Path;\n\nuse futures::Future;\nuse futures::future::BoxFuture;\nuse serde::Serialize;\n\n#[derive(Clone, Default, Debug)]\npub(crate) struct ApprovalStore {\n    // Store serialized keys for generic caching across requests.\n    map: BTreeMap&lt;String, ReviewDecision&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl ApprovalStore {\n    pub fn get&lt;K&gt;(&amp;self, key: &amp;K) -&gt; Option&lt;ReviewDecision&gt;\n    where\n        K: Serialize,\n    {\n        let s = serde_json::to_string(key).ok()?;\n        self.map.get(&amp;s).cloned()\n    }\n\n    pub fn put&lt;K&gt;(&amp;mut self, key: K, value: ReviewDecision)\n    where\n        K: Serialize,\n    {\n        if let Ok(s) = serde_json::to_string(&amp;key) {\n            self.map.insert(s, value);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Takes a vector of approval keys and returns a ReviewDecision.\n/// There will be one key in most cases, but apply_patch can modify multiple files at once.\n///\n/// - If all keys are already approved for session, we skip prompting.\n/// - If the user approves for session, we store the decision for each key individually\n///   so future requests touching any subset can also skip prompting.\npub(crate) async fn with_cached_approval&lt;K, F, Fut&gt;(\n    services: &amp;SessionServices,\n    // Name of the tool, used for metrics collection.",

detector\npub struct AstConflictDetector {\n    /// Repository path\n    repo_path: std::path::PathBuf,\n    /// Cached AST analysis results\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    ast_cache: Arc&lt;parking_lot::Mutex&lt;BTreeMap&lt;String, AstAnalysis&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\n/// AST analysis result for a file\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AstAnalysis {\n    /// Functions defined in the file\n    pub functions: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Structs/classes defined in the file\n    pub structs: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Imports used in the file\n    pub         "contents": "}\n\nimpl FileSystemScanner {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Result&lt;Self, Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {\n        let signatures = BTreeMap::new();\n        let suspicious_patterns = vec![\n            Regex::new(r\"(?i)eval\\s*\\(\")?, // Suspicious eval usage\n            Regex::new(r\"(?i)base64_decode\")?, // Base64 decoding\n            Regex::new(r\"(?i)system\\s*\\(\")?, // System calls\n        ];\n\n        Ok(Self {\n            signatures,\n            suspicious_patterns,\n            scan_history: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Signature-based scanning\n    pub fn signature_scan(&amp;self, directory: &amp;Path) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;ScanResult&gt;, Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {\n        let mut results = Vec::new();\n\n        for entry in WalkDir::new(directory).into_iter().filter_map(|e| e.ok()) {\n            if entry.file_type().is_file() {\n                let path = entry.path();\n                if let Ok(content) = fs::read(path) {\n                    let hash = format!(\"{:x}\", Sha256::digest(&amp;content));\n\n                    // Check against known malware signatures\n                    let threat_level = if self.signatures.contains_key(&amp;hash) {\n                        ThreatLevel::Malicious\n                    } else {\n                        ThreatLevel::Clean\n                    };\n\n                    let result = ScanResult {\n                        file_path: path.to_path_buf(),\n                        threat_level,\n                        confidence: if matches!(threat_level, ThreatLevel::Malicious) { 1.0 } else { 0.0 },\n                        signatures: if matches!(threat_level, ThreatLevel::Malicious) { vec![hash] } else { vec![] },\n                        behaviors: vec![],\n                        timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),\n                    };\n\n                    results.push(result);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(results)\n    }\n\n    /// Heuristic-based scanning\n    pub fn heuristic_scan(&amp;self, directory: &amp;Path) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;ScanResult&gt;, Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {\n        let mut results = Vec::new();\n\n        for entry in",

        "contents": "use bollard::Docker;\nuse bollard::container::Config;\nuse bollard::container::CreateContainerOptions;\nuse bollard::container::StartContainerOptions;\nuse bollard::image::CreateImageOptions;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::collections::BTreeSet;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\nuse tokio::sync::broadcast;\nuse tokio::sync::mpsc;\nuse tokio::time::Duration;\nuse tokio::time::{self};\n\n/// Container-based virtual OS management system\npub struct ContainerManager {\n    docker: Docker,\n    containers: Mutex&lt;BTreeMap&lt;String, VirtualEnvironment&gt;&gt;,\n    event_sender: broadcast::Sender&lt;ContainerEvent&gt;,\n    resource_manager: ResourceManager,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct VirtualEnvironment {\n    pub id: String,\n    pub name: String,\n    pub container_id: String,\n    pub image: String,\n    pub status: ContainerStatus,\n    pub ports: BTreeMap&lt;u16, u16&gt;,         // host_port -&gt; container_port\n    pub volumes: BTreeMap&lt;String, String&gt;, // host_path -&gt; container_path\n    pub environment: BTreeMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n    pub last_accessed: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n    pub allocated_resources: ResourceAllocation,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum ContainerStatus {\n    Creating,\n    Starting,\n    Running,\n    Paused,\n    Stopped,\n    Error(String),\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ResourceAllocation {\n    pub cpu_cores: f64,\n    pub memory_mb: u64,\n    pub disk_gb: u64,\n    pub network_bandwidth_mbps: u64,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum ContainerEvent {\n    ContainerCreated(String),\n    ContainerStarted(String),\n    ContainerStopped(String),\n    ContainerRemoved(String),\n    ResourceAllocated(String, ResourceAllocation),\n    Error(String, String),\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",

        "contents": "#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct CollaborationStore {\n    /// Shared context data (key-value store)\n    shared_context: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, Value&gt;&gt;,\n\n    /// Agent execution results\n    agent_results: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, AgentResult&gt;&gt;,\n\n    /// Task-level metadata\n    task_metadata: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, Value&gt;&gt;,\n\n    /// Message queue for inter-agent communication\n    message_queue: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;AgentMessage&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n\n    /// Last recorded orchestration metrics\n    metrics_state: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, OrchestrationMetrics&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl CollaborationStore {\n    /// Create a new collaboration store.\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            shared_context: Arc::new(DashMap::new()),\n            agent_results: Arc::new(DashMap::new()),\n            task_metadata: Arc::new(DashMap::new()),\n            message_queue: Arc::new(DashMap::new()),\n            metrics_state: Arc::new(DashMap::new()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Share context data with a specific key.\n    pub fn share_context(&amp;self, key: String, value: Value) {\n        self.shared_context.insert(key, value);\n    }\n\n    /// Get context data by key.\n    pub fn get_context(&amp;self, key: &amp;str) -&gt; Option&lt;Value&gt; {\n        self.shared_context\n            .get(key)\n            .map(|entry| entry.value().clone())\n    }\n\n    /// Get all context entries.\n    pub fn get_all_context(&amp;self) -&gt; Vec&lt;(String, Value)&gt; {\n        self.shared_context\n            .iter()\n            .map(|entry| (entry.key().clone(), entry.value().clone()))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    /// Store an agent's result.\n    pub fn store_agent_result(&amp;self, agent_name: String, result: AgentResult) {\n        self.agent_results.insert(agent_name, result);\n    }\n\n    /// Get a specific agent's result.\n    pub fn get_agent_result(&amp;self, agent_name: &amp;str) -&gt; Option&lt;AgentResult&gt; {\n        self.agent_results\n            .get(agent_name)\n            .map(|entry| entry.value().clone())\n    }\n\n    /// Get all agent results.",

        "contents": "//! Resource Monitor for Hardware and Performance Tracking\n//!\n//! Monitors GPU/CPU temperatures, memory usage, and manages concurrent execution limits\n//! Provides real-time resource monitoring for AI development workflows\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap as HashMap;\nuse crate::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\nuse sysinfo::System;\nuse tokio::sync::mpsc;\nuse tokio::sync::oneshot;\n\n/// Hardware sensor readings\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct HardwareSensors {\n    pub cpu_temperature: Option&lt;f32&gt;,\n    pub gpu_temperature: Option&lt;f32&gt;,\n    pub gpu_fan_speed: Option&lt;f32&gt;,\n    pub memory_usage_percent: f32,\n    pub memory_used_gb: f64,\n    pub memory_total_gb: f64,\n    pub cpu_usage_percent: f32,\n    pub gpu_usage_percent: Option&lt;f32&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Resource limits configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ResourceLimits {\n    pub max_memory_percent: f32, // 85% default\n    pub max_cpu_temp_celsius: f32,\n    pub max_gpu_temp_celsius: f32,\n    pub max_concurrent_tasks: usize,\n    pub gpu_required: bool,\n}\n\n/// Resource monitoring event\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum ResourceEvent {\n    LimitExceeded {\n        resource_type: String,\n        current_value: f64,\n        limit_value: f64,\n        recommendation: String,\n    },\n    SensorAlert {\n        sensor_type: String,\n        value: f64,\n        threshold: f64,\n        severity: AlertSeverity,\n    },\n    ResourceOptimized {\n        action_taken: String,\n        resources_freed: String,\n    },\n}\n\n/// Alert severity levels\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum AlertSeverity {\n    Low,\n    Medium,\n    High,\n    Critical,\n}\n\n/// Concurrent execution manager\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct ExecutionManager {\n    active_tasks: BTreeMap&lt;String, TaskInfo&gt;,",

        "contents": "#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct AgentCoordinator {\n    pub agent_registry: TokioRwLock&lt;BTreeMap&lt;String, AgentInfo&gt;&gt;,\n    pub task_queue: TokioRwLock&lt;BinaryHeap&lt;TaskAssignment&gt;&gt;,\n    pub active_assignments: TokioRwLock&lt;BTreeMap&lt;String, String&gt;&gt;, // task_id -&gt; agent_id\n    pub coordination_rules: Vec&lt;CoordinationRule&gt;,\n    pub load_balancer: LoadBalancer,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct AgentInfo {\n    pub identity: AgentIdentity,\n    pub current_workload: f64,\n    pub capabilities: Vec&lt;AgentCapability&gt;,\n    pub performance_metrics: AgentPerformanceMetrics,\n    pub availability_status: AgentAvailability,\n    pub last_heartbeat: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n    pub terminal_sessions: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentPerformanceMetrics {\n    pub average_task_completion_time: Duration,\n    pub success_rate: f64,\n    pub specialization_score: BTreeMap&lt;AgentCapability, f64&gt;,\n    pub resource_efficiency: f64,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\npub enum AgentAvailability {\n    Available,\n    Busy,\n    Offline,\n    Maintenance,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct TaskAssignment {\n    pub task_id: String,\n    pub agent_id: String,\n    pub priority_score: Reverse&lt;i32&gt;, // Reverse for max-heap behavior\n    pub compatibility_score: f64,\n    pub estimated_completion_time: Duration,\n}\n\nimpl Ord for TaskAssignment {\n    fn cmp(&amp;self, other: &amp;Self) -&gt; std::cmp::Ordering {\n        self.priority_score\n            .cmp(&amp;other.priority_score)\n            .then_with(|| {\n                self.compatibility_score\n                    .partial_cmp(&amp;other.compatibility_score)\n                    .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)\n            })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl PartialOrd for TaskAssignment {\n    fn partial_cmp(&amp;self, other: &amp;Self) -&gt; Option&lt;std::cmp::Ordering&gt; {\n        Some(self.cmp(other))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl PartialEq for TaskAssignment",

        "contents": "    async fn scan_file_internal(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; Result&lt;Option&lt;MalwareInfo&gt;&gt; {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n\n        // Read file content\n        let content = tokio::fs::read(path).await?;\n        let content_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;content);\n\n        // Calculate file hash\n        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n        hasher.update(&amp;content);\n        let hash = format!(\"{:x}\", hasher.finalize());\n\n        // Check hash signatures\n        for signature in &amp;self.malware_signatures {\n            if signature.signature_type == \"hash\" &amp;&amp; hash.contains(&amp;signature.pattern) {\n                let malware_info = MalwareInfo {\n                    malware_type: \"Hash-based detection\".to_string(),\n                    confidence: 0.95,\n                    threat_level: signature.threat_level,\n                    signatures_matched: vec![signature.description.clone()],\n                };\n\n                // Quarantine file\n                self.quarantined_files.insert(path.to_path_buf());\n\n                self.log_event(SecurityEvent::MalwareDetected {\n                    file_path: path.to_path_buf(),\n                    malware_type: malware_info.malware_type.clone(),\n                    confidence: malware_info.confidence,\n                    actions_taken: vec![\"quarantined\".to_string()],\n                });\n\n                return Ok(Some(malware_info));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check pattern signatures\n        for signature in &amp;self.malware_signatures {\n            if signature.signature_type == \"pattern\"",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "//! Connection manager for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.\n//!\n//! The [&#96;McpConnectionManager&#96;] owns one [&#96;codex_rmcp_client::RmcpClient&#96;] per\n//! configured server (keyed by the *server name*).         "contents": "//! Selective tool loader for task-based MCP tool loading.\n//!\n//! This module provides functionality to analyze tasks and load only the necessary\n//! MCP tools, reducing token consumption.\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::Mutex;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::info;\n\nuse crate::mcp_dynamic_loader::DynamicMcpLoader;\nuse crate::mcp_token_optimizer::McpTokenOptimizer;\n\n/// Selective tool loader for task-based loading\n#[allow(dead_code)]\npub struct SelectiveToolLoader {\n    optimizer: Arc&lt;McpTokenOptimizer&gt;,\n    dynamic_loader: Arc&lt;DynamicMcpLoader&gt;,\n    task_tool_mapping: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;BTreeMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl SelectiveToolLoader {\n    /// Create a new selective tool loader\n    pub fn new(optimizer: Arc&lt;McpTokenOptimizer&gt;, dynamic_loader: Arc&lt;DynamicMcpLoader&gt;) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            optimizer,\n            dynamic_loader,\n            task_tool_mapping: Arc::new(Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new())),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Load tools for a specific task\n    pub async fn load_for_task(&amp;self, task_description: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt; {\n        info!(\"Analyzing task requirements: {}\", task_description);\n\n        // Analyze task to determine required tools\n        let required_tools = self.analyze_task_requirements(task_description).await;\n\n        info!(\n            \"Task requires {} tools: {:?}\",\n            required_tools.len(),\n            required_tools\n        );\n\n        // Generate task ID\n        let task_id = format!(\"task_{}\", uuid::Uuid::new_v4());\n\n        // Store mapping\n        let mut mapping = self.task_tool_mapping.lock().await;\n        mapping.insert(task_id.clone(), required_tools.clone());\n\n        Ok(required_tools)\n    }\n\n    /// Unload tools after task completion\n    pub async fn unload_after_task(&amp;self, task_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let mut mapping = self.task_tool_mapping.lock().await;\n\n        if let Some(tools) = mapping.remove(task_id)",

        "contents": "    scorer: CompetitionScorer,\n}\n\nimpl CompetitionRunner {\n    /// Create a new competition runner\n    pub fn new(config: CompetitionConfig, repo_root: PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let worktree_manager = WorktreeManager::new(repo_root, config.worktree_base.clone())?;\n\n        let scorer = CompetitionScorer::new(config.weights.clone());\n\n        Ok(Self {\n            config,\n            worktree_manager,\n            scorer,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Run competition\n    pub async fn run_competition(&amp;self, blueprint: &amp;PlanBlock) -&gt; Result&lt;CompetitionResult&gt; {\n        let start = std::time::Instant::now();\n\n        info!(\n            \"Starting competition with {} variants for plan {}\",\n            self.config.num_variants, blueprint.id\n        );\n\n        // Create variants\n        let variant_names: Vec&lt;String&gt; = (0..self.config.num_variants)\n            .map(|i| format!(\"{}\", (b'A' + i as u8) as char))\n            .collect();\n\n        let mut variants = Vec::new();\n\n        for name in &amp;variant_names {\n            let worktree_path = self.worktree_manager.create_worktree(name)?;\n\n            // Execute task in worktree (stub - actual execution would happen here)\n            // TODO: Integrate with actual task execution\n\n            // Score variant\n            let score = self\n                .scorer\n                .score_variant(&amp;worktree_path, &amp;blueprint.eval)\n                .await?;\n\n            variants.push(CompetitionVariant {\n                name: name.clone(),\n                branch: format!(\"plan-competition-{name}\"),\n                worktree_path,\n                score,\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Find winner\n        let winner_idx = variants\n            .iter()\n            .enumerate()\n            .max_by(|(_, a), (_, b)| a.score.total.partial_cmp(&amp;b.score.total).unwrap())\n            .map(|(idx, _)| idx)\n            .unwrap_or(0);\n\n        variants[winner_idx].score.mark_winner();\n        let winner_name = variants[winner_idx].name.clone();\n\n        // Generate comparison table\n        let comparison_table =",

Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        info!(\"📢 Sending Slack notification: {}\", message.text);\n\n        let webhook_url = self\n            .webhook_url\n            .as_ref()\n            .context(\"Slack webhook URL not configured\")?;\n\n        // TODO: Actual Slack webhook POST\n        debug!(\"Webhook URL: {}\", webhook_url);\n        debug!(\"Message: {:?}\", message);\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Post message to channel (using Bot Token)\n    pub async fn post_message(\n        &amp;self,\n        channel: &amp;str,\n        text: &amp;str,\n        _blocks: Option&lt;Vec&lt;SlackBlock&gt;&gt;,\n    ) -&gt;         "contents": "pub struct LinearProgrammingSolver;\n\nimpl LinearProgrammingSolver {\n    /// Solve linear programming problem\n    pub fn solve(&amp;self, problem: &amp;OptimizationProblem) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;f64&gt;&gt; {\n        // Simplified Simplex algorithm implementation\n        // In practice, you would use a proper LP solver like highs or coin-or\n\n        let n = problem.variables.len();\n        let m = problem.constraints.len();\n\n        // Create tableau\n        let mut tableau = Array2::&lt;f64&gt;::zeros((m + 1, n + m + 1));\n\n        // Fill objective function row (last row)\n        for (i, coeff) in problem.objective.coefficients.iter().enumerate() {\n            let coeff = match problem.objective.direction {\n                OptimizationDirection::Maximize =&gt; -*coeff,\n                OptimizationDirection::Minimize =&gt; *coeff,\n            };\n            tableau[[m, i]] = coeff;\n        }\n\n        // Fill constraint rows\n        for (i, constraint) in problem.constraints.iter().enumerate() {\n            for (j, coeff) in constraint.coefficients.iter().enumerate() {\n                tableau[[i, j]] = *coeff;\n            }\n\n            // Slack variables\n            tableau[[i, n + i]] = 1.0;\n\n            // RHS\n            tableau[[i, n + m]] = constraint.rhs;\n        }\n\n        // Solve using Simplex\n        self.simplex_solve(&amp;mut tableau, n, m)?;\n\n        // Extract solution\n        let mut solution = Vec::new();\n        for i in 0..n {\n            let col = tableau.column(i);\n            let basic_var_index = col\n                .iter()\n                .position(|&amp;x| x == 1.0)\n                .filter(|&amp;idx| idx &lt; m)\n                .unwrap_or(m);\n\n            if basic_var_index &lt; m {\n                solution.push(tableau[[basic_var_index, n + m]]);\n            } else {\n                solution.push(0.0);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(solution)\n    }\n\n    fn simplex_solve",

        "contents": " {\n    // Future: AI model integration\n}\n\nimpl CommitQualityAnalyzer {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {}\n    }\n\n    /// Analyze commit quality using AI\n    pub async fn analyze_commit(\n        &amp;self,\n        _repo_path: &amp;str,\n        commit_sha: &amp;str,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;CommitQualityScore&gt; {\n        // TODO: Integrate with Codex API for AI analysis\n        // For now, return mock data for UI development\n\n        let mock_score = self.generate_mock_score(commit_sha);\n        Ok(mock_score)\n    }\n\n    /// Analyze multiple commits in batch\n    pub async fn analyze_commits_batch(\n        &amp;self,\n        _repo_path: &amp;str,\n        commit_shas: &amp;[String],\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;CommitQualityScore&gt;&gt; {\n        let mut scores = Vec::new();\n\n        for sha in commit_shas {\n            let score = self.analyze_commit(_repo_path, sha).await?;\n            scores.push(score);\n        }\n\n        Ok(scores)\n    }\n\n    // Mock data generator for development\n    fn generate_mock_score(&amp;self, sha: &amp;str) -&gt; CommitQualityScore {\n        // Generate pseudo-random but consistent scores based on SHA\n        let hash_val = sha.bytes().fold(0u32, |acc, b| acc.wrapping_add(b as u32));\n        let base_score = (hash_val % 40) as f32 + 50.0; // 50-90 range\n\n        CommitQualityScore {\n            sha: sha.to_string(),\n            code_quality: base_score + ((hash_val % 10) as f32),\n            test_coverage: base_score - ((hash_val % 15) as f32),\n            documentation: base_score + ((hash_val % 5) as f32),\n            complexity: 100.0 - base_score, // Inverse for complexity\n            overall: base_score,\n            insights: vec![\n                \"Code follows project conventions\".to_string(),\n                \"Good variable naming\".to_string(),\n            ],\n            issues: vec![],\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for CommitQualityAnalyzer {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Get color representation for quality score\npub fn score_to_color(score: f32) -&gt; &amp;'static str {\n    match score {\n        s if s &gt;= 80.0 =&gt;         "contents": "//! Parallel AI execution orchestration\n//!\n//! Executes multiple AI agents (Codex, GeminiCLI, Claudecode) in parallel\n//! for competition-style development with worktree isolation.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Stdio;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::process::Command;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::task::JoinHandle;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceGuard;\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceManager;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeInfo;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeManager;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningSummary;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::Verbosity;\nuse codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AgentType {\n    Codex,\n    GeminiCLI,\n    Claudecode,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]\npub struct ReasoningConfig {\n    pub effort: ReasoningEffort,\n    pub summary: ReasoningSummary,\n    pub verbosity: Verbosity,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentTask {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub prompt: String,\n    pub worktree_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub timeout_seconds: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    pub reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentResult {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub success: bool,\n    pub output: String,\n    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,\n    pub error: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum AgentStatus {\n    Pending,\n    Running,\n    Completed,\n    Failed,\n    Timeout,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentProgress {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub status: AgentStatus",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "//! Git Repository Parser for Git4D VR/AR Sprint 1\n//!\n//! This module implements the core Git repository parsing engine that extracts\n//! commit data and transforms it into 4D visualization structures.\n//!\n//! Key Features:\n//! - Complete Git history parsing using git2-rs\n//! - 4D data structure transformation (x, y, z, time)\n//! - Memory-efficient processing for large repositories\n//! - Parallel processing capabilities\n\nuse async_trait::async_trait;\nuse git2::{Commit, Oid, Repository};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};\n\n/// Represents a parsed Git commit with 4D coordinates\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Git4DCommit {\n    pub id: String,\n    pub author: String,\n    pub email: String,\n    pub timestamp: i64,\n    pub message: String,\n    pub parents: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub branch: String,\n    pub tags: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    // 4D coordinates for visualization\n    pub x: f32,    // Branch position\n    pub y: f32,    // Time-normalized position\n    pub z: f32,    // Commit depth/impact\n    pub time: f32, // Normalized timestamp\n    // Additional metadata\n    pub files_changed: usize,\n    pub insertions: usize,\n    pub deletions: usize,\n}\n\n/// Configuration for Git repository parsing\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct GitParseConfig {\n    pub repository_path: String,\n    pub max_commits: Option&lt;usize&gt;,\n    pub branch_filter: Option&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n    pub date_range: Option&lt;(i64, i64)&gt;,\n    pub include_merges: bool,\n    pub parallel_workers: usize,\n}\n\n/// Statistics from Git repository parsing\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct GitParseStats {\n    pub total_commits: usize,\n    pub total_branches: usize,\n    pub total_tags: usize,\n    pub date_range: (i64, i64),\n    pub processing_time_ms: u128,\n    pub memory_usage_mb: usize,\n}\n\n/// Git Repository Parser Engine\npub struct GitRepositoryParser {\n    config: GitParseConfig,\n}",

        "contents": "    fn train_single_linear_regression(\n        &amp;self,\n        features: &amp;[Vec&lt;f64&gt;],\n        targets: &amp;[f64],\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;f64&gt;, String&gt; {\n        let n_features = features[0].len();\n        let n_samples = features.len();\n\n        // Normal equations: (X^T * X)^(-1) * X^T * y\n        // Using Rust 2024 generic const expressions for compile-time sizing\n\n        // Calculate X^T * X\n        let mut xtx = vec![vec![0.0; n_features]; n_features];\n        for i in 0..n_features {\n            for j in 0..n_features {\n                xtx[i][j] = features\n                    .iter()\n                    .map(|sample| sample[i] * sample[j])\n                    .sum::&lt;f64&gt;();\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Calculate X^T * y\n        let mut xty = vec![0.0; n_features];\n        for i in 0..n_features {\n            xty[i] = features\n                .iter()\n                .zip(targets.iter())\n                .map(|(sample, &amp;target)| sample[i] * target)\n                .sum::&lt;f64&gt;();\n        }\n\n        // Solve normal equations (simplified - in production use proper linear algebra library)\n        // For now, return mock coefficients\n        Ok(vec![\n            0.1, 0.15, -0.05, -0.08, 0.12, 0.09, 0.06, 0.11, -0.03, 0.07,\n        ])\n    }\n\n    async fn train_random_forest(\n        &amp;self,\n        _features: &amp;[Vec&lt;f64&gt;],\n        _targets: &amp;QualityTargets,\n        _hyperparams: &amp;Hyperparameters,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;QualityPredictionModel, String&gt; {\n        // Placeholder implementation\n        // In full implementation, would build random forest\n        Err(\"Random Forest training not yet implemented\".to_string())\n    }\n\n    async fn train_neural_network(\n        &amp;self,\n        _features: &amp;[Vec&lt;f64&gt;]",

        "contents": "use std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse anyhow::anyhow;\nuse sha1::digest::Output;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse crate::protocol::FileChange;\n\nconst ZERO_OID: &amp;str = \"0000000000000000000000000000000000000000\";\nconst DEV_NULL: &amp;str = \"/dev/null\";\n\nstruct BaselineFileInfo {\n    path: PathBuf,\n    content: Vec&lt;u8&gt;,\n    mode: FileMode,\n    oid: String,\n}\n\n/// Tracks sets of changes to files and exposes the overall unified diff.\n/// Internally, the way this works is now:\n/// 1. Maintain an in-memory baseline snapshot of files when they are first seen.\n///    For new additions, do not create a baseline so that diffs are shown as proper additions (using /dev/null).\n/// 2. Keep a stable internal filename (uuid) per external path for rename tracking.\n/// 3.         "contents": "    }\n\n    /// Measure performance (stub - could run benchmarks)\n    async fn measure_performance(&amp;self, _worktree_path: &amp;PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;f64&gt; {\n        // TODO: Run actual benchmarks\n        // For now, return baseline score\n        Ok(85.0)\n    }\n\n    /// Measure code simplicity (LOC, complexity metrics)\n    async fn measure_simplicity(&amp;self, worktree_path: &amp;PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;f64&gt; {\n        // Count lines of code (simple metric)\n        let output = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .current_dir(worktree_path)\n            .args([\"diff\", \"HEAD~1\", \"--shortstat\"])\n            .output()\n            .context(\"Failed to run git diff\")?;\n\n        if output.status.success() {\n            let diff_stat = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);\n            // Parse lines changed (lower is better for simplicity)\n            // This is a simple heuristic\n            let lines = diff_stat\n                .split_whitespace()\n                .filter_map(|s| s.parse::&lt;u32&gt;().ok())\n                .sum::&lt;u32&gt;();\n\n            // Score: fewer lines = higher score\n            let score = 100.0 - (lines as f64 * 0.1).min(50.0);\n            Ok(score.max(50.0))\n        } else {\n            Ok(75.0) // Default simplicity score\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Competition runner\npub struct CompetitionRunner {\n    config: CompetitionConfig,\n    worktree_manager: WorktreeManager,\n    scorer: CompetitionScorer,\n}\n\nimpl CompetitionRunner",
